title: Machine learning enables full Bayesian inference for spinning extreme-mass-ratio inspirals
abstract: arXiv:2611.31916v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs), stellar-mass compact objects spiralling into massive black holes, promise to measure the masses and spins of the central black holes, reveal the strong-field environment around them and gauge cosmic distances via millihertz gravitational-wave observations. Yet most forecasts for the parameter inference of these systems assume known source parameters, and broad-prior analyses have addressed only simplified versions of the problem. The joint inversion of all 14 parameters of a spinning source from the complete prior has remained unsolved. Here we solve it for the augmented analytic kludge model: generative networks narrow the complete prior and reveal a ring of degenerate spin directions, and the exact detector likelihood determines the posterior. translated_title: 机器学习使自旋极端质量比旋近的完整贝叶斯推断成为可能
translated_abstract: 极端质量比旋近（EMRI）是指恒星级致密天体螺旋坠入大质量黑洞的过程，通过毫赫兹引力波观测，这类系统有望测量中心黑洞的质量与自旋、揭示其周围的强场环境，并用于探测宇宙距离。然而，大多数针对这些系统参数推断的预测研究都假设源参数已知，而采用宽先验的分析也仅处理了该问题的简化版本。从完整先验出发对自旋源的全部14个参数进行联合反演，这一问题一直悬而未决。在本文中，我们针对增广解析杂凑（augmented analytic kludge）模型解决了这一问题：生成式网络缩小了完整先验的范围，并揭示出一个自旋方向简并的环，随后精确的探测器似然函数确定出后验分布。对于模拟的一年期LISA-Taiji联合观测，我们在一个环扇区内首次获得了自旋EMRI的14参数后验分布……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究首次借助生成式机器学习网络缩小完整先验并结合精确探测器似然函数，实现了对自旋极端质量比旋近（EMRI）全部14个参数的联合贝叶斯后验推断。
en_tdlr: This work achieves, for the first time, full 14-parameter Bayesian inference of a spinning EMRI from the complete prior, by using generative machine learning networks to narrow the prior and the exact detector likelihood to determine the posterior.
